Class SequentialProgression

java.lang.Object
aslframework.game.progression.AbstractLetterProgression
aslframework.game.progression.SequentialProgression
All Implemented Interfaces:
LetterProgression
public class SequentialProgression extends AbstractLetterProgression
Sequential progression through ASL letters A → Z.

Used by practice mode to present letters in alphabetical order. Filters to only letters with loaded reference gestures in the library.
